patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Download the patch from the link below. Once you have downloaded the file, locate the steam directory for the game (right click on the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) To apply the patch, copy the 'game' folder from within the 'club life patch' folder in the archive to the game install folder mentioned in (1), merging the folders if asked, and overwriting files when p It's working if: It says 'Uncensored Edition' (instead of 'Steam Version') on the main menu of the game. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
